title: Hermes Agent Setup
description: Pull hermes-agent, create identity directory, run setup once, then start with mounted volumes.

steps.description: Pull: docker pull nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest fetches the image.
Identity directory: mkdir creates $HOME/agents/hermes/home for persistent data.
Setup: --rm -it container with volume mount runs setup wizard to write config and keys.
Run: thereafter, start hermes with identity and workspace volumes mounted.
